notes.title: Citadale - The Legends Trilogy Official Soundtrack Release
notes.notes:
The Citadale - The Legends Trilogy Soundtrack contains all 32 tracks from all three games in full chiptune glory. Composed by Ezekiel Rage and Trevor Lentz it features over an hour of music.
Everyone who bought Citadale - The Legends Trilogy on Steam can now download the entire soundtrack for free.

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, a new update for the game has just been released. 

What's new?
- Added a double check for boss rooms in the second Chapter
- Tweaked enemy placement even further
- Finetuned the hit detection even more
- Some graphical upgrades in the backgrounds

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Citadale - The Legends Trilogy has been recently updated. 

Changelog:

Fixed a bug in keyboard mode that stopped a cutscene
Added save states: Press F1 or the left analog stick to save a state and press F2 or the right analog stick to load a savestate. 
Note: Savestates are universal so it's ONE savestate for all three chapters!
